integrity: Complete self-contained proof plus standalone auxiliary numerical verification; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Stationary repeated independent exposures, known constant Doppler drift, exact matched filtering, photon noise proportional to exposure; nonnegative strictly decreasing autocorrelation. No finite-transit sampling, variable drift, nuisance spectra, correlated or detector read noise, data-driven detrending, or empirical validation; broad historical priority provisional.
title: A unique Doppler-smearing exposure optimum and two overhead power laws
